title: Reel set — one entry of config/reel-sets.json
description: Definition of one reel set (per game state / feature tier / RTP profile). config/reel-sets.json is an array whose every element validates against this schema. A reel set is either strip-based (physical reel strips, stops selected on the strip) or weighted-table-based (per-reel symbol weight maps); exactly one of the two representations must be present, matching the declared mode.

setId.description: Unique id of this reel set, e.g. "base-96", "feature_strips", "ultimate-feature-96".

purpose.description: Game context this reel set is used in. Tier purposes match the canonical tier ids; bonus_buy_entry sets generate the guaranteed-trigger entry spin of a bought feature.

mode.description: Representation of the reels: physical strips or per-reel weighted symbol tables.

stopSelection.description: How the RNG picks stops: uniformly over strip positions (strips mode) or by weight draw (weightedTable mode).

rtpProfileId.description: RTP profile (from game-config.json rtpProfiles) this set belongs to. Omitted = valid for all profiles.

strips.description: One strip per reel, left to right; array length must equal the grid's column count (config validator). Present iff mode is "strips".

items.description: Ordered symbol strip for this reel; stops wrap around the ends.
Symbol id at this strip position.

weightedTable.description: One weight map per reel, left to right; array length must equal the grid's column count (config validator). Present iff mode is "weightedTable".

items.description: Map from symbol id to integer draw weight for this reel.

^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,15}$.description: Relative draw weight of this symbol on this reel.

scatterPositionRules.description: Optional constraints on where scatters may land, used to shape trigger odds and anticipation.

maxScattersPerReel.description: Maximum simultaneous visible scatters on one reel.

allowedReels.description: Zero-based reel indices where scatters may appear at all.

minGapPositions.description: Minimum strip positions between two scatters on the same strip (strips mode only).

allOf.$comment: Validation message: 'mode "strips" requires the strips array (and forbids weightedTable); stopSelection must be uniform_strip.'
Validation message: 'mode "weightedTable" requires the weightedTable array (and forbids strips); stopSelection must be weighted.'

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
